事情.zh: 这几天我脑袋里的事情太多了。
事情.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒ nǎo dai lǐ de shì qing tài duō le
事情.en: I have too many things on my mind these days.
事情.es: Tengo demasiadas cosas en la cabeza estos días.

事情.zh: 我跟父母讲了留学的事情。
事情.pinyin: Wǒ gēn fù mǔ jiǎng le liú xué de shì qing
事情.en: I talked with my parents about my studying abroad.
事情.es: Hablé con mis padres acerca de estudiar en el extranjero.

事情.zh: 生活就是当你忙著进行你的计划时总有其他的事情发生。
事情.pinyin: Shēng huó jiù shì dāng nǐ máng zhe jìn xíng nǐ de jì huà shí zǒng yǒu qí tā de shì qing fā shēng
事情.en: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.
事情.es: La vida es lo que te pasa mientras estás ocupado haciendo otros planes.

事情.zh: 我肯定事情会往好的方向发展。
事情.pinyin: Wǒ kěn dìng shì qing huì wǎng hǎo de fāng xiàng fā zhǎn
事情.en: I am sure the situation will take a turn for the better.
事情.es: Estoy seguro de que las condiciones cambiarán para mejor.

报纸.zh: 我能不能看一下你的报纸？
报纸.pinyin: Wǒ néng bù néng kàn yī xià nǐ de bào zhǐ
报纸.en: Can I have a look at your newspaper?

报纸.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài kàn bào zhǐ
Wǒ zài bào zhǐ shàng kàn dào le tā
报纸.en: I saw it in the newspaper.
报纸.es: Lo he leído en el periódico.

报纸.zh: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。
报纸.pinyin: Zài nàr kàn bào zhǐ de nán rén shì wǒ shū shu
报纸.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
报纸.es: El hombre que está allá leyendo un diario es mi tío.

试.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zuì hǎo bié shì
试.en: I think it's better not to try it.
试.es: Creo que es mejor no intentarlo.

试.zh: 在考期末试前那阵子我应该再努力一点。
试.pinyin: Zài kǎo qī mò shì qián nà zhèn zi wǒ yīng gāi zài nǔ lì yī diǎn
试.en: I should have studied harder before the term exams.
试.es: Debería haber estudiado más antes de los exámenes parciales.

试.pinyin: Wǒ máng yú yìng fu qī mò kǎo shì
试.en: I was busy studying for the term exam.
试.es: Estaba ocupado con trabajo para el examen final.

小心.zh: 虽然他很小心，但还是犯了个想不到的错误。
小心.pinyin: Suī rán tā hěn xiǎo xīn dàn hái shi fàn le gè xiǎng bu dào de cuò wù
小心.en: Careful as he was, he made an unexpected mistake.
小心.es: Pese a que era prudente, cometió un error inesperado.

小心.zh: 小心不要弄醒了正在睡觉的婴儿。
小心.pinyin: Xiǎo xīn bù yào nòng xǐng le zhèng zài shuì jiào de yīng ér
小心.en: Take care not to awake the sleeping baby.
小心.es: Ten cuidado de no despertar a la bebé.

小心.zh: 小心点驾驶，不然你就麻烦了。
小心.pinyin: Xiǎo xīn diǎn jià shǐ bù rán nǐ jiù má fan le
小心.en: Be careful driving or you'll have problems.
小心.es: Ten cuidado conduciendo o tendrás problemas.

小心.zh: 你自己小心，玩得开心点！
小心.pinyin: Nǐ zì jǐ xiǎo xīn wán de kāi xīn diǎn
小心.en: Take care of yourself, and have a good time!

根据.zh: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。
根据.pinyin: Gēn jù nǐ suǒ shuō de huà wǒ rèn wéi wǒ men yīng gāi chóng xīn shěn shì wǒ men de jì huà
根据.en: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
根据.es: A la luz de lo que nos dijo, creo que deberíamos revisar nuestro plan.

根据.zh: 你这种想法有没有根据？
根据.pinyin: Nǐ zhè zhǒng xiǎng fǎ yǒu méi yǒu gēn jù
根据.en: Do you have any grounds for thinking so?

根据.zh: 这个故事是根据真人真事写成的。
根据.pinyin: Zhè ge gù shi shì gēn jù zhēn rén zhēn shì xiě chéng de
根据.en: This story is based on facts.
根据.es: Esta historia está basada en hechos.

根据.zh: 不能根据服装来判断一个人。
根据.pinyin: Bù néng gēn jù fú zhuāng lái pàn duàn yī gè rén
根据.en: You can't judge a person based on clothing.
根据.es: No se puede juzgar a una persona por su ropa.

中间.zh: 我坐在汤姆和约翰中间。
中间.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài tāng mǔ hé yuē hàn zhōng jiān
中间.en: I sat between Tom and John.
中间.es: Me senté entre Tom y John.

中间.pinyin: Lǎo hǔ tǎng zài lóng zi de zhōng jiān
中间.en: The tiger laid in the middle of the cage.
中间.es: El tigre se recostó en el medio de la jaula.

中间.zh: 在那个时候，汤姆正坐在玛丽和约翰中间。
中间.pinyin: Zài nà ge shí hou tāng mǔ zhèng zuò zài mǎ lì hé yuē hàn zhōng jiān
中间.en: At that time, Tom was sitting between Mary and John.
中间.es: En aquel momento, Tom estaba sentado entre Mary y John.

中间.pinyin: Lù zhōng jiān yǒu yī liàng kǎ chē
中间.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
中间.es: Hay un camión en medio de la carretera.

生活.pinyin: Wǒ xué huì le bù kào tā shēng huó
生活.en: I learned to live without her.

生活.pinyin: Tā men guo zhe hé píng de shēng huó
Méi yǒu diàn shì wǒ wú fǎ shēng huó

生活.zh: 生活就是当你忙著进行你的计划时总有其他的事情发生。
生活.pinyin: Shēng huó jiù shì dāng nǐ máng zhe jìn xíng nǐ de jì huà shí zǒng yǒu qí tā de shì qing fā shēng
生活.en: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.
生活.es: La vida es lo que te pasa mientras estás ocupado haciendo otros planes.

厕所.zh: 我能用一下你们的厕所吗？
厕所.pinyin: Wǒ néng yòng yī xià nǐ men de cè suǒ ma

厕所.zh: 请问这儿附近有没有厕所？
厕所.pinyin: Qǐng wèn zhèr fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu cè suǒ
厕所.en: Excuse me, is there a toilet nearby?
厕所.es: Perdone, ¿hay algún baño cerca de aquí?

迷路.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ wǒ mí lù le

迷路.zh: 我迷路了，能不能请您帮我一下？
迷路.pinyin: Wǒ mí lù le néng bù néng qǐng nín bāng wǒ yī xià
迷路.en: I am lost. Can you help me, please?
迷路.es: Me he perdido. ¿Me puede ayudar, por favor?

迷路.pinyin: Bù hǎo yì si wǒ mí lù le

迷路.zh: 我第一次来拜访你的时候迷路了。
迷路.pinyin: Wǒ dì yī cì lái bài fǎng nǐ de shí hou mí lù le
迷路.en: I got lost when I visited you for the first time.
迷路.es: Me perdí la primera vez que fui a visitarte.

至少.zh: 我弟弟非常重要。至少他认为他是。
至少.pinyin: Wǒ dì di fēi cháng zhòng yào zhì shǎo tā rèn wéi tā shì
至少.en: My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.
至少.es: Mi hermano es muy importante. O al menos él piensa que lo es.

至少.zh: 我们每天至少该睡八小时。
至少.pinyin: Wǒ men měi tiān zhì shǎo gāi shuì bā xiǎo shí
至少.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
至少.es: Tenemos que dormir al menos ocho horas por día.

至少.pinyin: Tā zhì shǎo yǒu yī qiān běn shū
至少.en: He has at least one thousand books.
至少.es: Él tiene cuanto menos mil libros.

至少.zh: 当她在洛杉矶的时候, 她至少有六份工作。
至少.pinyin: Dāng tā zài luò shān jī de shí hou tā zhì shǎo yǒu liù fèn gōng zuò
至少.en: When she was in Los Angeles, she had at least six different jobs.
至少.es: Cuando estuvo en Los Ángeles, ella tuvo al menos seis trabajos diferentes.

对于.pinyin: Duì yú nà ge wǒ bù què xìn
对于.en: I am not certain about that.
对于.es: No estoy seguro acerca de eso.

对于.zh: 你对于现在的年轻人有什么看法？
对于.pinyin: Nǐ duì yú xiàn zài de nián qīng rén yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
对于.en: What do you think about young people today?
对于.es: ¿Qué piensas sobre la juventud de hoy?

对于.zh: 对于他来说，这是一件十分重要的事情。
对于.pinyin: Duì yú tā lái shuō zhè shì yī jiàn shí fēn zhòng yào de shì qing
对于.en: For him, this is a serious enough matter.

对于.zh: 对于他的康复没有任何希望。
对于.pinyin: Duì yú tā de kāng fù méi yǒu rèn hé xī wàng
对于.en: There's no chance that he'll recover.

底.zh: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。
底.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ kàn le tā zuì xīn jù de dǐ gǎo
底.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
底.es: Él me enseñó el manuscrito de su nueva obra.

底.zh: 那儿的水深到我碰不到底。
底.pinyin: Nàr de shuǐ shēn dào wǒ pèng bù dào dǐ
底.en: The water there was so deep that I could not touch bottom.
底.es: El agua ahí estaba tan profunda que no podía tocar el fondo.

底.zh: 你需要携带两张白底的个人证件照。
底.pinyin: Nǐ xū yào xié dài liǎng zhāng bái dǐ de gè rén zhèng jiàn zhào
底.en: You will need to bring two passport-sized photos of yourself taken with a white background.
底.es: Tendrá que traer dos fotos de tamaño pasaporte tomadas con un transfondo blanco.

底.zh: 您需要带两张本人的白底报名照。
底.pinyin: Nín xū yào dài liǎng zhāng běn rén de bái dǐ bào míng zhào
底.en: You will need to bring two passport-sized photos of yourself taken with a white background.
底.es: Tendrá que traer dos fotos de tamaño pasaporte tomadas con un transfondo blanco.

小吃.zh: 派对上有很多美味的小吃。
小吃.pinyin: Pài duì shàng yǒu hěn duō měi wèi de xiǎo chī
小吃.en: There were many delicious snacks at the party.
小吃.es: En la fiesta había muchos bocaditos sabrosos.

项目.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de xiàng mù

项目.zh: 让我们继续进行议程上的项目。
项目.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men jì xù jìn xíng yì chéng shàng de xiàng mù
项目.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
项目.es: Procedamos con el orden del día.

项目.zh: 他们一起为这个项目工作过。
项目.pinyin: Tā men yī qǐ wèi zhè ge xiàng mù gōng zuò guo
项目.en: They worked jointly on this project.

项目.pinyin: Gōng sī fàng qì le nà ge xiàng mù

温暖.zh: 我想找一件温暖的羊毛裙。
温暖.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī jiàn wēn nuǎn de yáng máo qún
温暖.en: I'm looking for a warm, woolen skirt.
温暖.es: Busco una cálida falda de lana.

温暖.zh: 对一年的这个时候来说，天气很温暖。
温暖.pinyin: Duì yī nián de zhè ge shí hou lái shuō tiān qì hěn wēn nuǎn
温暖.en: It's warm for this time of year.
温暖.es: Hace calor para esta época del año.

温暖.pinyin: Jīn tiān hěn wēn nuǎn bù shì ma

温暖.zh: 这些花生长在温暖的国家。
温暖.pinyin: Zhè xiē huā shēng cháng zài wēn nuǎn de guó jiā
温暖.en: These flowers grow in warm countries.
温暖.es: Estas flores crecen en países cálidos.

权利.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu quán lì gān shè
权利.en: I had no right to interfere.
权利.es: No tenía ningún derecho a interferir.

权利.zh: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。
权利.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fǎ lǜ huì bō duó wǒ men de jī běn quán lì
权利.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
权利.es: Esta ley nos privará de nuestros derechos básicos.

权利.zh: 人有选择的权利，但是奴隶却只有服从的份儿。
权利.pinyin: Rén yǒu xuǎn zé de quán lì dàn shì nú lì què zhǐ yǒu fú cóng de fènr
权利.en: A man chooses; a slave obeys.
权利.es: Un hombre elige; un esclavo obedece.

权利.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī dào wǒ men de quán lì

士兵.pinyin: Shì bīng gěi le wǒ shuǐ
士兵.en: The soldier gave water to me.

士兵.zh: 士兵们失去了战斗的勇气。
士兵.pinyin: Shì bīng men shī qù le zhàn dòu de yǒng qì
士兵.en: The soldiers lost the courage to fight.
士兵.es: Los soldados perdieron el valor para combatir.

士兵.pinyin: Xǔ duō shì bīng zài zhè lǐ zhèn wáng
士兵.en: A lot of soldiers were killed here.

士兵.zh: 士兵们已经准备好为国牺牲了。
士兵.pinyin: Shì bīng men yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo wèi guó xī shēng le
士兵.en: The soldiers were ready to die for their country.
士兵.es: Los soldados estaban dispuestos a morir por su país.

主席.zh: 他们让约翰做了委员会的主席。
主席.pinyin: Tā men ràng yuē hàn zuò le wěi yuán huì de zhǔ xí
主席.en: They made John chairman of the committee.
主席.es: Nombraron a John presidente del comité.

主席.pinyin: Wǒ men xuǎn le tā dāng zhǔ xí

主席.zh: 我们选出了詹姆斯当主席。
主席.pinyin: Wǒ men xuǎn chū le zhān mǔ sī dāng zhǔ xí

主席.zh: 你赞成也好，不赞成也好，我也会推荐他当主席的。
主席.pinyin: Nǐ zàn chéng yě hǎo bù zàn chéng yě hǎo wǒ yě huì tuī jiàn tā dāng zhǔ xí de
主席.en: I'll recommend him as chairman, whether you are in favour of it or not.

日常.zh: 大部分人写的东西是关于他们的日常生活的。
日常.pinyin: Dà bù fen rén xiě de dōng xi shì guān yú tā men de rì cháng shēng huó de
日常.en: Most people write about their daily life.
日常.es: La mayoría de la gente escribe sobre su vida cotidiana.

日常.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
日常.pinyin: Diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
日常.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.
日常.es: La televisión ocupa un lugar importante en el diario vivir.

日常.zh: 他的日常行为并不和他的原则相一致。
日常.pinyin: Tā de rì cháng xíng wéi bìng bù hé tā de yuán zé xiāng yī zhì
日常.en: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.

日常.zh: 他们坚持认为日常锻练是必得表出的行为。
日常.pinyin: Tā men jiān chí rèn wéi rì cháng duàn liàn shì bì děi biǎo chū de xíng wéi
日常.en: They insist that daily exercise is an action that must be done.

绕.zh: 地球每二十四小时就会绕轴自转一周。
绕.pinyin: Dì qiú měi èr shí sì xiǎo shí jiù huì rào zhóu zì zhuàn yī zhōu
绕.en: The earth revolves on its axis once every 24 hours.
绕.es: La Tierra gira alrededor de su eje una vez cada 24 horas.

绕.pinyin: Gǒu rào zhe zhuō zi zǒu
绕.en: The dog is walking around the table.
绕.es: El perro está dando vueltas alrededor de la mesa.

绕.pinyin: Dì qiú rào zhe tài yang zhuǎn
绕.en: The Earth moves around the sun.
绕.es: La Tierra se mueve alrededor del Sol.

绕.zh: 许多卫星绕著土星运行。
绕.pinyin: Xǔ duō wèi xīng rào zhe tǔ xīng yùn xíng
绕.es: Muchas lunas orbitan alrededor de Saturno.

展开.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。
展开.pinyin: Wǒ men fēn sàn kāi lái bìng zài shù lín zhōng zhǎn kāi sōu suǒ
展开.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.

展开.zh: 几天之内，德军便在波兰境内展开了大规模攻击。
展开.pinyin: Jǐ tiān zhī nèi dé jūn biàn zài bō lán jìng nèi zhǎn kāi le dà guī mó gōng jī
展开.en: Within days, German forces fanned out across Poland.

展开.zh: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。
展开.pinyin: Zhè chǎng tán lùn jí jiāng duì wū rǎn wèn tí zhǎn kāi tǎo lùn
展开.en: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.

撕.pinyin: Wǒ sī kāi le xìn fēng

撕.zh: 看了信之后，她把它撕成碎片。
撕.pinyin: Kàn le xìn zhī hòu tā bǎ tā sī chéng suì piàn
撕.en: After she had read the letter, she tore it to pieces.
撕.es: Después de leer la carta, la rompió en pedacitos.

撕.zh: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。
撕.pinyin: Tāng mǔ cóng tā de huì huà běn shàng sī xià le yī yè
撕.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.

撕.pinyin: Nà ge nǚ hái bǎ bù sī le

内部.zh: 我们还应该看下这个房子的内部。
内部.pinyin: Wǒ men hái yīng gāi kàn xià zhè ge fáng zi de nèi bù
内部.en: We should look inside this house as well.

内部.zh: 电脑内部计时器内的纽扣电池没电了。
内部.pinyin: Diàn nǎo nèi bù jì shí qì nèi de niǔ kòu diàn chí méi diàn le
内部.en: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.

晕.pinyin: Wǒ hái yūn yūn hu hū de
Tā kàn jiàn xuè jiù yūn le
晕.en: She fainted when she saw blood.

晕.pinyin: Tā jī hū hē yūn le

电台.es: Él sale ahora en la radio.

电台.zh: 你最喜欢的电台是什么？
电台.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐ huan de diàn tái shì shén me
电台.es: ¿Cuál es tu emisora de radio favorita?

电台.pinyin: Wǒ huì zài diàn tái qián děng nǐ
电台.en: I will wait for you in front of the radio station.

电台.zh: 电台没有提到这个事故。
电台.pinyin: Diàn tái méi yǒu tí dào zhè ge shì gù
电台.en: The radio didn't mention the incident.

手工.zh: 这块地毯是手工制作的。
手工.pinyin: Zhè kuài dì tǎn shì shǒu gōng zhì zuò de
手工.es: Esta alfombra es hecha a mano.

手工.zh: 我在新竹买了一块手工柿饼，味道甜而不腻。
手工.pinyin: Wǒ zài xīn zhú mǎi le yī kuài shǒu gōng shì bǐng wèi dao tián ér bù nì
手工.en: I bought a handmade dried persimmon in Hsinchu. It tastes sweet but not greasy.

语气.zh: 你有没有发现他说话的语气有点古怪？
语气.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu fā xiàn tā shuō huà de yǔ qì yǒu diǎn gǔ guài
语气.en: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?
语气.es: ¿Te diste cuenta de ese tono extraño en su voz?

语气.zh: 他说话的语气好像是在害怕什么。
语气.pinyin: Tā shuō huà de yǔ qì hǎo xiàng shì zài hài pà shén me
语气.en: He speaks as though he were afraid of something.

样式.pinyin: Yǒu qí tā yàng shì ma

样式.zh: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。
样式.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fu yàng shì dào shi tǐng hǎo jiù shì guì le diǎnr
样式.en: The style of this item of clothing is good; it's just a bit expensive.

样式.zh: 他穿衣服一向很随便，颜色、样式都无所谓。
样式.pinyin: Tā chuān yī fú yī xiàng hěn suí biàn yán sè yàng shì dōu wú suǒ wèi
样式.en: He always dresses very casually, and doesn't care about color or style.

汇率.pinyin: Jīn tiān de huì lǜ shì duō shao
汇率.en: What is the exchange rate today?
汇率.es: ¿Cuál es el tipo de cambio hoy?

汇率.pinyin: Wài bì de huì lǜ tiān tiān dōu biàn
汇率.en: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
汇率.es: Las tasas de cambio de las divisas varían diariamente.
¿A cuánto está el cambio de moneda?

流泪.zh: 如果，错过太阳的时候你在流泪，那么你也将错过群星。
流泪.pinyin: Rú guǒ cuò guò tài yang de shí hou nǐ zài liú lèi nà me nǐ yě jiāng cuò guò qún xīng
流泪.en: If you cry because you miss the sun when it goes away, then you will also miss the stars.
流泪.es: Si lloras porque te has perdido el sol, entonces también te perderás las estrellas.

流泪.pinyin: Tā liú lèi kàn zhe xìn

兑换.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng duì huàn lǚ xíng zhī piào
兑换.en: I'd like to cash a travelers' check.
兑换.es: Me gustaría cambiar un cheque de viajero.

兑换.zh: 我可以在这里兑换这张支票吗？
兑换.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ duì huàn zhè zhāng zhī piào ma
兑换.en: Can I cash this check here?

事故.zh: 事故耽误了我们半小时。
事故.pinyin: Shì gù dān wu le wǒ men bàn xiǎo shí
事故.en: An accident delayed us for half an hour.
事故.es: Un accidente hizo que nos demoráramos por una hora y media.

事故.zh: 事故由一个简单的错误产生。
事故.pinyin: Shì gù yóu yī ge jiǎn dān de cuò wù chǎn shēng
事故.en: The accident arose from a simple mistake.
事故.es: El accidente se dio debido a un sencillo error.

事故.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
事故.pinyin: Shì gù chà diǎn ràng tā diū le xìng mìng
事故.en: The accident almost cost him his life.
事故.es: El accidente casi le costó la vida.

事故.pinyin: Shì gù fā shēng zài qián tiān
事故.en: The accident happened the day before yesterday.

期望.zh: 我期望能在圣诞节见到你。
期望.pinyin: Wǒ qī wàng néng zài shèng dàn jié jiàn dào nǐ
期望.en: I hope I can see you at Christmas.

期望.zh: 当你提出一个问题，你期望得到答案。
期望.pinyin: Dāng nǐ tí chū yī ge wèn tí nǐ qī wàng dé dào dá àn
期望.en: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
期望.es: Cuando haces una pregunta, esperas una respuesta.

期望.zh: 英国期望每个人都会尽义务。
期望.pinyin: Yīng guó qī wàng měi ge rén dū huì jìn yì wù
期望.en: England expects that every man will do his duty.
期望.es: Inglaterra espera que todo hombre cumpla con su deber.

期望.zh: 其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。
期望.pinyin: Qí tā rén de qī wàng huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ men de xíng wéi
期望.en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.

井.pinyin: Zhè kǒu jǐng gān hé le
Zhè kǒu jǐng lǐ méi yǒu shuǐ
井.en: There is no water in the well.
井.es: No hay más agua en el pozo.

井.en: The money is in the well.
井.es: El dinero está en el pozo.

井.zh: 含义是哪里有水井，哪里就有居民。
井.pinyin: Hán yì shì nǎ lǐ yǒu shuǐ jǐng nǎ lǐ jiù yǒu jū mín
井.en: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
井.es: La implicación era que donde había un pozo, había residentes.

看待.zh: 他把我当成陌生人来看待。
看待.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ dàng chéng mò shēng rén lái kàn dài
看待.en: He treats me as if I am a stranger.
看待.es: Él me trata como si fuera un extraño.

看待.zh: 我不喜欢给人当成小孩子般看待。
看待.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan gěi rén dàng chéng xiǎo hái zi bān kàn dài
看待.en: I don't like being treated like a child.
看待.es: No me gusta que me traten como a un niño.

看待.zh: 人们看待事情的角度不同取决於他们是富裕或贫穷。
看待.pinyin: Rén men kàn dài shì qing de jiǎo dù bù tóng qǔ jué yú tā men shì fù yù huò pín qióng
看待.en: People look at things differently depending on whether they are rich or poor.
看待.es: Una persona ve las cosas de manera diferente dependiendo de si es rica o pobre.

看待.zh: 他不想被当成孩子看待。
看待.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng bèi dàng chéng hái zi kàn dài
看待.en: He objects to being treated like a child.
看待.es: Él se opone a ser tratado como un niño.

拿手.pinyin: Zhè bu shì wǒ ná shǒu de
Yùn dòng wǒ bù ná shǒu
拿手.en: I am not good at sports.
拿手.es: No soy bueno para los deportes.

拿手.zh: 千万别相信一个手里拿手枪的女人。
拿手.pinyin: Qiān wàn bié xiāng xìn yī ge shǒu lǐ ná shǒu qiāng de nǚ rén
拿手.en: Never trust a woman with a pistol in hand.
拿手.es: Nunca confíes en una mujer que tenga una pistola en la mano.

拿手.zh: 为什么你做饭那么拿手呢？
拿手.pinyin: Wèi shén me nǐ zuò fàn nà me ná shǒu ne
拿手.en: Why are you so good at cooking?
拿手.es: ¿Cómo es que se te da tan bien la cocina?

统治.zh: 统治一个国家不是一件简单的工作。
统治.pinyin: Tǒng zhì yī ge guó jiā bù shì yī jiàn jiǎn dān de gōng zuò
统治.en: To rule a country is no easy task.
统治.es: Gobernar un país no es una tarea fácil.

统治.zh: 这位领导人统治了他的国家五十年。
统治.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǐng dǎo rén tǒng zhì le tā de guó jiā wǔ shí nián
统治.en: The leader governed his country for more than 50 years.
统治.es: El líder gobernó su país por más de 50 años.

统治.zh: 统治一个国家不是一个简单活。
统治.pinyin: Tǒng zhì yī ge guó jiā bù shì yī ge jiǎn dān huó
统治.en: To govern a country is no easy job.
统治.es: Gobernar un país no es una tarea fácil.

统治.zh: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。
统治.pinyin: Yǒu xiē rén shuō rì běn shì gè nán xìng tǒng zhì de shè huì
统治.en: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.
统治.es: Algunas personas dicen que Japón es una sociedad dominada por los hombres.

阻碍.zh: 没有什么能阻碍我邪恶的计划。
阻碍.pinyin: Méi yǒu shén me néng zǔ ài wǒ xié è de jì huà
阻碍.en: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.

阻碍.zh: 电影中的怪兽会践踏阻碍它的一切事物。
阻碍.pinyin: Diàn yǐng zhòng dì guài shòu huì jiàn tà zǔ ài tā de yī qiè shì wù
阻碍.en: The monster in the movie would stomp on anything that got in its way.

阻碍.pinyin: Huǒ shān huī zǔ ài háng yùn

保障.pinyin: Píng děng shì yóu xiàn fǎ bǎo zhàng de
保障.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
保障.es: La igualdad es garantizada por la constitución.

保障.zh: 思想自由为宪法所保障。
保障.pinyin: Sī xiǎng zì yóu wèi xiàn fǎ suǒ bǎo zhàng
保障.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.

清晨.zh: 我不喜欢在清晨开的会议。
清晨.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan zài qīng chén kāi de huì yì
清晨.en: I don't like early morning meetings.
清晨.es: No me gustan las reuniones a primera hora de la mañana.

清晨.zh: 清晨，鲍勃遇见了她的祖父。
清晨.pinyin: Qīng chén bào bó yù jiàn le tā de zǔ fù
清晨.en: Bob met her grandfather early in the morning.

清晨.pinyin: Tā qīng chén lí kāi le
清晨.en: She left early in the morning.

清晨.pinyin: Cóng qīng chén kāi shǐ yī zhí xià yǔ
清晨.en: It's been raining since early morning.

奥秘.zh: 生活的伟大奥秘其中之一是猫如何决定下一步要做什么。
奥秘.pinyin: Shēng huó de wěi dà ào mì qí zhōng zhī yī shì māo rú hé jué dìng xià yī bù yào zuò shén me
奥秘.en: One of the great mysteries of life is how a cat decides what to do next.
奥秘.es: Uno de las grandes misterios de la vida es cómo un gato decide qué hacer después.

奥秘.pinyin: Shéi néng jiē kāi hǎi yáng de ào mì
奥秘.en: Who shall ever unravel the mysteries of the sea?

贩卖.zh: 她在演唱会的场地贩卖毒品。
贩卖.pinyin: Tā zài yǎn chàng huì de chǎng dì fàn mài dú pǐn
贩卖.es: Ella está vendiendo drogas en los recitales.

贩卖.pinyin: Nǐ men yǒu fàn mài shuǐ guǒ ma

贩卖.zh: 然后又把各书名揭示通衢，永远禁止贩卖。
贩卖.pinyin: Rán hòu yòu bǎ gè shū míng jiē shì tōng qú yǒng yuǎn jìn zhǐ fàn mài
贩卖.en: Then they displayed all the book titles publicly and banned their sale forever.

侥幸.zh: 好险啊，还好侥幸逃过一劫。
侥幸.pinyin: Hǎo xiǎn a hái hǎo jiǎo xìng táo guò yī jié
侥幸.en: That was so dangerous! Fortunately, I narrowly escaped a disaster.

内在.zh: 是我内在的兽性想要它。
内在.pinyin: Shì wǒ nèi zài de shòu xìng xiǎng yào tā
内在.en: It's the animal in me that wants it.
内在.es: Es el animal dentro de mí que lo quiere.

内在.zh: 我们一定不能忘记每个人的内在价值。
内在.pinyin: Wǒ men yī dìng bù néng wàng jì měi ge rén de nèi zài jià zhí
内在.en: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.

卡通.zh: 书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。
卡通.pinyin: Shū zhuō shàng yī dié zhuān yè shū lǐ yǒu jǐ běn kǎ tōng shū hún zài lǐ miàn
卡通.en: There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.
卡通.es: Había algunos libros de historietas mezclados con la pila de libros especializados del escritorio.

卡通.zh: 有人说电视上的卡通本身是有教育意义的。
卡通.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō diàn shì shàng de kǎ tōng běn shēn shì yǒu jiào yù yì yì de
卡通.en: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.

掩盖.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu shì tú yǎn gài zhēn xiàng
掩盖.en: She didn't try to hide the truth.

电源.zh: 这个男人简直像一台被扯掉了电源的肮脏电器。
电源.pinyin: Zhè ge nán rén jiǎn zhí xiàng yī tái bèi chě diào le diàn yuán de āng zāng diàn qì
电源.en: This man is like a filthy electronic without a battery.

电源.zh: 电源转接器的包装盒在哪里？
电源.pinyin: Diàn yuán zhuǎn jiē qì de bāo zhuāng hé zài nǎ lǐ
电源.en: Where's the box the power supply came in?

里程碑.zh: 登月是一项里程碑式的成就。
里程碑.pinyin: Dēng yuè shì yī xiàng lǐ chéng bēi shì de chéng jiù
里程碑.en: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.

之际.zh: 他在要结婚之际决定还是不结婚了。
之际.pinyin: Tā zài yào jié hūn zhī jì jué dìng hái shi bù jié hūn le
之际.en: Shortly before his wedding, he decided not to get married.

发财.en: I don't want to be rich.

发财.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì yào fā cái le
发财.en: Tom and Mary are going to be rich.

安详.zh: 她在睡眠中安详地去世了。
安详.pinyin: Tā zài shuì mián zhōng ān xiáng de qù shì le
安详.en: She passed away peacefully in her sleep.

安详.zh: 他昨晚在家中安详地离世了。
安详.pinyin: Tā zuó wǎn zài jiā zhōng ān xiáng de lí shì le
安详.en: He passed on quietly at his home last night.

清澈.zh: 你的歌声像太平洋的海水一样清澈。
清澈.pinyin: Nǐ de gē shēng xiàng tài píng yáng de hǎi shuǐ yī yàng qīng chè
清澈.en: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.

清澈.zh: 你的歌声清澈如太平洋的海水。
清澈.pinyin: Nǐ de gē shēng qīng chè rú tài píng yáng de hǎi shuǐ
清澈.en: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.

照样.zh: 他没有朋友，没有钱，没有房子……他照样玩得很开心。
照样.pinyin: Tā méi yǒu péng you méi yǒu qián méi yǒu fáng zi tā zhào yàng wán de hěn kāi xīn
照样.en: He had no friends, no money, no home...but he played happily all the same.
照样.es: Él no tiene amigos, dinero, casa... pero se lo pasa bien igualmente.

照样.zh: 就算这样地球也照样转！
照样.pinyin: Jiù suàn zhè yàng dì qiú yě zhào yàng zhuǎn

留神.zh: 请留神看著我的手提箱。
留神.pinyin: Qǐng liú shén kàn zhe wǒ de shǒu tí xiāng
留神.en: Please keep an eye on my suitcase.

留神.pinyin: Yào liú shén tā bù róng yì shòu piàn
留神.en: Be careful. He's not an easy one to swindle.

磕.zh: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。
磕.pinyin: Tā kē suì le xià ba diào le jǐ kē yá
磕.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
磕.es: Se rompió la mandíbula y perdió algunos dientes.

起伏.pinyin: Shēng huó zhōng yǒu gāo dī qǐ fú
起伏.en: In life there are ups and downs.

起伏.pinyin: Rén shēng chōng mǎn le gāo dī qǐ fú
起伏.en: Life is full of ups and downs.

阵地.zh: 士兵们撤离了他们的阵地。
阵地.pinyin: Shì bīng men chè lí le tā men de zhèn dì
阵地.en: The soldiers retreated from their positions.

玛丽.pinyin: Tā jiào mǎ lì shì wǒ de mì shū
玛丽.en: Her name is Mary, she is my secretary.
玛丽.es: Ella se llama Mari, es mi secretaria.

玛丽.zh: 我对玛丽的帮助表示了感谢。
玛丽.pinyin: Wǒ duì mǎ lì de bāng zhù biǎo shì le gǎn xiè
玛丽.en: I thanked Mary for her help.
玛丽.es: Agradecí a Mary por su ayuda.

玛丽.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn shì mǎ lì xiě de ma
玛丽.en: Was this letter written by Mary?

玛丽.zh: 那不可能是玛丽，她现在在医院。
玛丽.pinyin: Nà bù kě néng shì mǎ lì tā xiàn zài zài yī yuàn
玛丽.en: That can't be Mary. She's in the hospital now.
玛丽.es: No puede ser Mary. Está ahora mismo en el hospital.

下来.zh: 我们的火车突然停了下来。
下来.pinyin: Wǒ men de huǒ chē tū rán tíng le xià lai
下来.es: Nuestro tren se detuvo de repente.

下来.pinyin: Lǎo rén zuò le xià lai

下来.zh: 她总是把老师说的话一字不差地记下来。
下来.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì bǎ lǎo shī shuō de huà yī zì bù chà de jì xià lai
下来.en: She always writes down every word her teacher says.
下来.es: Ella siempre anota cada palabra que dice el profesor.

下来.zh: 他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。
下来.pinyin: Tā shī qù le píng héng cóng tī zi shàng shuāi le xià lai
下来.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.
下来.es: Él perdió el equilibrio y se cayó de la escalera.

怕.pinyin: Méi shén me hǎo pà de
怕.en: There's nothing to be afraid of.

怕.pinyin: Wǒ pà nǐ méi fǎ gēn tā jié hūn
怕.en: I'm afraid you can't marry her.
怕.es: Me temo que no te puedes casar con ella.

怕.pinyin: Tā shuō tā pà tiān huì xià yǔ
怕.en: He said that he was afraid it would be rainy.

看来.zh: 看来他出国学习的目的是要提高他说英语的能力。
看来.pinyin: Kàn lai tā chū guó xué xí de mù dì shì yào tí gāo tā shuō yīng yǔ de néng lì
看来.en: It seems that the purpose of his study abroad was to improve his ability to speak English.
看来.es: Al parecer, su propósito de estudiar en el extranjero es desarrollar su capacidad para hablar el inglés.

看来.pinyin: Kàn lai tā gǎo cuò le
看来.en: It appears that he is mistaken.

看来.zh: 看来他曾经是个有钱人。
看来.pinyin: Kàn lai tā céng jīng shì gè yǒu qián rén
看来.en: He seemed to have been rich.

看来.pinyin: Kàn lai tā huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yi
看来.en: It appears that she might change her mind.
看来.es: Parece que ella podría cambiar de opinión.

那边.zh: 站在那边的男孩是我的儿子。
那边.pinyin: Zhàn zài nà bian de nán hái shì wǒ de ér zi
那边.en: The boy standing over there is my son.
那边.es: El chico que está parado por allá es mi hijo.

那边.zh: 在那边游泳的男孩是谁？
那边.pinyin: Zài nà bian yóu yǒng de nán hái shì shéi
那边.en: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
那边.es: ¿Quién es el chico que está nadando por ahí?

那边.zh: 你看，那边正在冒烟，那栋大厦一定是失火了。
那边.pinyin: Nǐ kàn nà bian zhèng zài mào yān nà dòng dà shà yī dìng shì shī huǒ le
那边.en: Look at that smoke. That building must be on fire.
那边.es: Mira qué humo. Ese edificio debe de estar ardiendo.

那边.pinyin: Dào nà bian xū yào duō cháng shí jiān
那边.en: How long will it take to get there?

中国人.zh: 你是中国人还是日本人？
中国人.pinyin: Nǐ shì zhōng guó rén hái shi rì běn rén
Zhǐ shì yóu zhōng guó rén fā míng de
中国人.en: Paper was invented by the Chinese.
中国人.es: El papel lo inventaron los chinos.

中国人.pinyin: Wáng xiān sheng shì zhōng guó rén
中国人.es: El Sr. Wang viene de China.

何.zh: 在任何情况下你都不能离开这个房间。
何.pinyin: Zài rèn hé qíng kuàng xià nǐ dōu bù néng lí kāi zhè ge fáng jiān
何.en: Under no circumstances must you leave the room.
